newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stocks up 0.9 pct in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks up 0.9 pct in moderate trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange gained ground in moderate trading in the week to Wednesday, a Muscat Securities Market report said.
The stock exchange index ended the week at 315.51 points, up 0.9 percent from the previous week's close of 312.80.
The total value traded in the week was 8.4 million rials ($22.3 milion), down from 19.3 million rials the previous week.
Volume fell to 3.2 million shares from 19.3 million the previous week.
Of the 76 stocks traded in the week, 33 rose, 20 were unchanged and the rest declined. ($1=0.377 rials)
